evidence.source: Contract 209 applied to Development on 20 August 2026 by fast-lane rollout run 32322676610 from exact main b9dd24f0d333917346cfab23ebd15f9de40d9e04, the merge commit of #935. A second fast-lane run, 32335240998 from main 06ab135a1745d32cc8ef05b157cb60a9609958e1, was dispatched later the same morning; it found nothing pending and its snapshot, apply and confirm steps are all recorded SKIPPED. It applied nothing and must not be cited as the run that moved this environment. Run 32322676610 is the one that did: it proved the pending migration additive by reading it, took the lightweight pre-apply snapshot, applied, and confirmed the hosted contract against the repository, every step concluding success between 01:54:00Z and 02:02:04Z. EVERYTHING BELOW IS AN INDEPENDENT READ-ONLY QUERY AGAINST DEVELOPMENT taken at 2026-08-20T05:24:08Z, separately from that run. The ledger holds 209 rows and NAMES 20260819200000 provider_fixture_lifecycle. ZERO TRANSITIONS IS THE CORRECT READING, NOT A FAILURE. No provider response has been consumed under 209 yet: the SportMonks target polls on a 1440-minute cadence, last dispatched 2026-08-19T15:40:00Z, so the first consumption under this contract falls due at 2026-08-20T15:40:00Z. That delay is the risk already recorded as ING-006 and it is unchanged by this rollout. THE TWO SEASON-RESOLUTION FAULTS ARE MEASURABLY REPAIRED ON THIS HOSTED DATABASE, against the real archived response of 2026-08-19T15:40:03Z: resolve_provider_season('sportmonks','28275') now returns tournament 6a64a59b-b721-443e-a864-0fd52db1edbd where it previously matched nothing, because the mapping is held under the composite key 501/28275; and provider_poll_path_pattern turns the stored path's {{date:+N}} placeholders into /fixtures/between/%/%?filters=fixtureLeagues:501&include=participants;scores;round, which the actually dispatched URL matches. Before 209 neither arm could resolve, which is why every response since 2026-08-10T15:27Z was consumed unresolved_season. NOT ONE PLAYER-OWNED ROW MOVED, every figure matching the Contract-208 record: 24 auth users, 24 profiles, 34 entries, 64 season predictions, 756 match predictions, 5 leagues, 39 league members and 578 season fixtures. Cron remains 14 jobs. THIS ROLLOUT SPENT NO PROVIDER CREDIT.
